contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ VICTORIAE DD AVGG Q NN ; D/ CONSTANT-[...] P F AVG

A copper-alloy nummus of Constantius II, AD337-361. Mint is Arles, AD347-348, (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads VICTORIAE DD AVGG Q NN. Reverse shows two Victories. See RIC VIII, p.209, no.78. Obverse shows rosette and laureate, diademed and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads CONSTANT-[...] P F AVG. Condition is very fine, die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 1.42g, diameter is…
